title: Royalty OS v0.2 Origin Record Schema
description: JSON Schema module for validating origin records in Royalty OS v0.2.

origin_id.description: A stable identifier for the origin.

title.description: The title or name of the origin.

creator.description: The creator, originator, author, maintainer, or origin node associated with the origin.

first_published.description: The first known publication date of the origin in YYYY-MM-DD format.

primary_url.description: The primary URL where the origin is published or recorded.

description.description: A short description of the origin.

language.description: The primary language of the origin, preferably using a BCP 47 language tag such as en or ja.

license.description: The license associated with the origin, if known.

repository.description: A repository URL associated with the origin, if applicable.

related_origins.description: Other origin identifiers related to this origin.

created_at.description: Timestamp when this origin record was created.

updated_at.description: Timestamp when this origin record was last updated.

status.description: Lifecycle status of the origin record.
